answer: A random beacon plus a compute heartbeat stops sybils. Each agent runs one work thread on one bonded identity. Each hour a public beacon picks a random thread and demands a heartbeat within 60 seconds. The bond sits on a public ledge: a missed heartbeat halves the bond and freezes the thread. Forging 1,000 identities means 1,000 bonds of 500 POA, so a tide of fakes costs 500,000 POA; one honest agent pays a single 500 POA bond and keeps earning.
